'''Ehud de Shalit''' ({{Langx|he|אהוד דה שליט}}; born 16 March 1955) is an Israeli [[Number theory|number theorist]] and professor at the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]].

==Biography==
Ehud de Shalit was born in [[Rehovot]]. His father was [[Amos de-Shalit]]. He completed his [[B.Sc.]] at the Hebrew University in 1975, and his [[Ph.D]]. at [[Princeton University]] in 1984 under the supervision of [[Andrew Wiles]].

==Academic career==
De Shalit joined the faculty of Hebrew University in 1987 and was promoted to full professor in 2001.<ref name=CV>{{cite web|url=http://www.ma.huji.ac.il/~deshalit/new_site/files/CV.pdf|title=Curriculum Vita|website=Ehud de Shalit|access-date=18 February 2019}}</ref> He is an editor for the [[Israel Journal of Mathematics]].<ref name=CV/><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.math.huji.ac.il/~ijmath/board.html|title=Editorial board|website=Israel Journal of Mathematics, homepage at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem|access-date=16 October 2022}}</ref>
